name: Thee Hypnotics
label: Beggars Banquet
lede: A High Wycombe band that worshipped the MC5 and the Stooges became Sub Pop's British connection, survived a Minneapolis bus wreck, and made its last album with a Black Crowe producing.

eras.title: Detroit, by way of Buckinghamshire
eras.text: Jim Jones and Ray Hanson built a band around the records nobody in late-80s England was supposed to love: the MC5, the Stooges, Blue Cheer.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography
years.h: Jones and Hanson start a band in High Wycombe
years.p: Jim Jones sings, Ray Hanson plays guitar, Mark Thompson drums and Adam Sharam plays bass. AllMusic sums up the plan: hard rock muscle plus Detroit high-decibel rebellion.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography
years.h: "Love in a Different Vein" on Vinyl Solution
years.p: The first 7-inch, backed with "All Night Long." AllMusic dates it to 1988.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography · Wikipedia (German): Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Will Pepper takes the bass for "Justice in Freedom"
years.p: [[Will Pepper|7c2437a8-a610-487f-9750-2cc4ca8a5a64]] replaces Chris Dennis, and the band's first Situation Two 12-inch becomes a minor hit.

eras.title: Sub Pop's men in England
eras.text: John Peel had them in, Sub Pop put them out in America, and Seattle's Backlash fanzine ran them next to Mudhoney and Nirvana. By 1990 they had an album on Beggars and RCA and fans in Sonic Youth and the Black Crowes.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: John Peel session at the BBC
years.p: Four songs for Radio 1: "Nine Times," "Love in a Different Vein," "Soul Trader" and "Let's Get Naked."

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · The Commercial Zone: Thee Hypnotics · Beggars Banquet: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Live'r Than God!, a live record for a debut
years.p: Situation Two in the UK and Sub Pop in the US. Wikipedia calls them Sub Pop's first UK signing, and Seattle became a second home.
years.xp: Seattle's Backlash fanzine put them on the same pages as [[Mudhoney|e675295a-1efe-4247-aa3b-53b78d0cdffc]], [[Screaming Trees|bc5e6e42-73ba-44fa-a41e-3379402f0429]] and [[Nirvana|5b11f4ce-a62d-471e-81fc-a69a8278c7da]]. Melody Maker heard reincarnation rather than anything new: the band as past, present and future at once.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: "Soul Trader" scrapes the chart at No. 159
years.p: A Situation Two 12-inch, followed the same year by "Floating in My Hoodoo Dream."

years.cap: Jim Jones, Ray Hanson, Will Pepper and Phil Smith
years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · Wikipedia (German): Thee Hypnotics
years.h: A Canadian drummer, Phil Smith, replaces Mark Thompson
years.p: Phil Smith joins in 1989 and stays through the end, and the reunion.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · Blurt: The Story Behind the Album, Soul Glitter & Sin · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography
years.h: Come Down Heavy, recorded in Soho, mixed in Seattle
years.p: Cut at Wardour Studios and mixed by [[Jack Endino|d06cca33-9167-4049-b5ce-6a6aeff60a8d]], with members of the Pretty Things sitting in. No. 2 on the UK indie chart.
years.xp:
Hanson's description of the sound: "blues, high energy, rock 'n' roll Marshall amp."

[[Thurston Moore|8ba48525-d922-42ee-9775-97b7b8f9712e]], Mike McCready and Chris Robinson all championed it. Wikipedia says Robinson made it the Black Crowes' tour bus soundtrack and wore a Thee Hypnotics shirt in a Rolling Stone poster.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Reading main stage, on a bill with Mudhoney and Sonic Youth
years.p: [[Nick Cave and the Bad Seeds|172e1f1a-504d-4488-b053-6344ba63e6d0]] play the same festival. That year they also support [[the Cramps|96c1edac-1011-4cb8-882c-27248de35071]] at Brixton Academy.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · Blurt: The Story Behind the Album, Soul Glitter & Sin · Vanguard Online: Thee Hypnotics, Righteously Re-Charged · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography
yt: Live at the Rat, Boston, March 1990
years.h: A drunk driver hits the tour bus after a Minneapolis show
years.p: The show was at Prince's club. The crash breaks Phil Smith's back and hips and keeps him in hospital for nine months. Rat Scabies of the Damned covers the UK dates.
years.xp:
It ended the band's first US tour. Hanson told Blurt the wreck forced a break that shaped where the music went next.

Robert Zyn came in as a second guitarist after the accident, according to AllMusic.

eras.title: John Barry in a garage band
eras.text: The second album swapped Marshalls for Fender Twins and Detroit for film noir, with horns and harp. Then second guitarist Craig Pike died.

years.src: Blurt: The Story Behind the Album, Soul Glitter & Sin · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography
years.h: John Leckie takes them to Rockfield for Soul, Glitter & Sin
years.p: Three to four weeks in Wales, up to five guitars a track, plus the Kick Horns, piano, Hammond, marimba and harp. Hanson's models were film composers.
years.xp:
Hanson named John Barry, Lalo Schifrin, Bernard Herrmann and Elmer Bernstein, along with Tom Waits, Nick Cave and Captain Beefheart. Side one is crime and menace; side two is the late-night side.

Leckie, who had produced Syd Barrett and the Stone Roses, recorded at Rockfield and Monnow Valley. AllMusic says reviews were lukewarm; Hanson told Blurt the references weren't considered cool by the era's "musical gentry."

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · Blurt: The Story Behind the Album, Soul Glitter & Sin
years.h: Two nights at Hammersmith Odeon with the Black Crowes
years.p: The band opens the Black Crowes' UK tour. They also tour Europe with [[the Cult|8846e4ff-0c19-4af2-872b-7a8dc7497f68]] on the Ceremonial Stomp dates.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: "Coast to Coast" gets to No. 118
years.p: Melody Maker calls it a return to the burnouts of the early singles. "Shakedown" follows on Beggars and RCA.

years.src: AllMusic: Thee Hypnotics biography · The Commercial Zone: Thee Hypnotics · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Second guitarist Craig Pike dies of an overdose
years.p: Pike, who had played with Iggy Pop, replaced Robert Zyn. AllMusic dates his death to 1992; [[Mark Lanegan|a9126556-f555-4920-9617-6e013f8228a7]] writes about him in Sing Backwards and Weep.

eras.title: Chris Robinson at the controls
eras.text: The Black Crowes' singer brought them to Los Angeles and Rick Rubin's American Recordings. The album came out in America, got stuck in a distribution fight in Europe, and sold badly.

years.src: Vanguard Online: Thee Hypnotics, Righteously Re-Charged · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics · Wikipedia (German): Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Chris Robinson produces The Very Crystal Speed Machine in LA
years.p: American Recordings in the US, SPV in Europe. Vanguard says a legal dispute between American and its European distributors kept it from a proper UK release.
years.xp:
Vanguard's Ross McGibbon says Robinson ran the sessions hard, "banning band members according to attitude or drug use."

Wikipedia says poor sales and distribution of the record took the momentum out of the band.

years.cap: Gig poster, the Weathered Wall, Seattle, July 29, 1994
years.src: Vanguard Online: Thee Hypnotics, Righteously Re-Charged · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Small American clubs in a yellow school bus
years.p: Vanguard says they toured little US venues in "a clapped-out yellow school bus." At the Viper Room, Wikipedia lists Johnny Depp, Harry Dean Stanton and Cher in the crowd.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: "Earth Blues 99" on Rocket Recordings
years.p: A last 7-inch, backed with "Thing 4 U." Jeremy Cottingham is on bass now.

years.src: Blurt: The Story Behind the Album, Soul Glitter & Sin · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Thee Hypnotics break up; Hanson turns down the Sisters of Mercy
years.p: Hanson steps away from the music business for 15 years. Jones fronts Black Moses.
years.xp:
Hanson's later project, Ray "Sonic" Hanson's Whores of Babylon, debuted at Portobello Live in May 2015. He told Blurt he has "at least a triple album" of unreleased Hypnotics material.

Pepper went on to record and tour with [[Hurricane #1|87788c91-a97e-40a8-860b-3d9a3956af5e]].

eras.title: Jim Jones Revue, then the reunion
eras.text: Jones found a second life fronting the Jim Jones Revue. Twenty years after the split, Beggars boxed up the albums and the band went back on the road.

years.src: Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Jim Jones starts the Jim Jones Revue
years.p: The Jim Jones Revue releases its debut in 2008. In October 2015 he forms Jim Jones and the Righteous Mind.

years.cap: Jim Jones and Ray Hanson in Milton Keynes, April 2018
years.src: Louder Than War: Thee Hypnotics announce 2018 reunion tour · Wikipedia: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Jones, Hanson, Smith and Cottingham reunite for 15 dates
years.p: The April tour runs through France and the UK, from Glasgow to Ramsgate, at £13 a ticket, £15 in London.

years.src: Discogs: Thee Hypnotics, Righteously Re-Charged · Vanguard Online: Thee Hypnotics, Righteously Re-Charged · Beggars Banquet: Thee Hypnotics
years.h: Beggars boxes all three albums, plus the early days
years.p: Four colored LPs, with The Very Crystal Speed Machine and In a Trance (Thee Early Daze 86-89), and notes by Julian Marszalek. Mojo gave it four stars.
